answer_1.quote: We first estimate the situated cognition ... then sample N candidate personalized responses ... the VLM assistant generates responses ... The selected optimal responses are expected to align well with individuals' personalized situated cognition ...
answer_1.outputs: personalized textual responses to visual queries

answer_2.quote: We adopt the "llm-as-a-judge" manner ... We report two metrics in the main results: (1) P. Score, which ranges from 1 to 5. (2) Win Rate, which is obtained by comparing the P. Score of the response being evaluated with that of the Base response.

answer_3.quote: We employ a Best-of-N strategy to select the optimal response ... The reward model is a key component ... we use GPT-4o-mini for all evaluations, which, through our human evaluation, demonstrates reliable evaluation quality.

answer_4.quote: We also ask human annotators to reassess which method's response is better ... human annotators agree with our designed automatic evaluation method in 88% of the cases.
answer_4.guideline: Human annotators compare responses from different methods and indicate which one is better overall.
